title.narrative: Maldives Strengthening of Procurement Regulatory Framework

description.narrative: (a) Regulatory and Institutional Reform Provision of technical assistance through the employment of a consultant to assist with: (i) the review of the Operational Manual (OM); (ii) the immediate need of incorporating the new provisions either in the Financial Regulations (FR) or in an attachment to the FR to maintain consistency with current financial regulation and provide necessary legal base within the shortest possible timeframe; (iii) the preparation of a basic suite of standard bidding documents and standard contract documents and technical guidance notes to cover those contracts; and (iv) the establishment of a national complaints mechanisms together with appropriate rules of procedure. (b),,Dispute Resolution Provision of technical assistance to assist with the preparation and drafting of an Arbitration Act and with the training of a core cadre of local arbitrators (c) Capacity Development Providing sustainable training program at a national level by: (i) conducting a pilot training program for: (A) procurement officers active in procurement under the Tsunami Relief and Reconstruction Fund (TRRF) and (B) services of the Chartered Institute of Purchasing and Supply to provide local training of trainers for the Higher Education College; and (ii) conducting a targeted training program including specialized training for auditors and other stakeholders. (d),,Public Awareness (i) Carrying out a public awareness campaign consisting of workshops and seminars for government officers, private sector contractors, suppliers and the general public; and (ii) creating an information procurement website. (e),,Preparatory Work of Introduction of E-Procurement (i) Conducting an initial needs and feasibility assessment to provide a basis for a phased approach for introducing e-procurement based on readiness of the public and private agencies and availability of technology; and (ii) provision of procurement equipment and materials to enhance the current capacity of e-advertising, e-issuance of documents and e-publication of awards.
